text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval for a bargaining mandate with IATSE Local 58 at the St. Lawrence Centre.

The TO Live - Human Resources and Stakeholder Relations Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the bargaining mandate with IATSE Local 58 at the St. Lawrence Centre, as noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 3, 2025) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Direct that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 3, 2025) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains labour relations information or employee negotiations.
